Starservant.name: Starservant
Starservant.basicInfo:
Starservant is a cult-like street villain encountered during the winter Endeavor Agency period. He delivers warnings of disaster with intense certainty and uses his Quirk, Control Glass, to turn nearby glass into a public hazard. His declarations are claims he makes, not reliable narration of the future. An elderly, slender man, he has a deeply wrinkled face, a large white beard and blank, pupil-less eyes. A disheveled dark cloak, bracelets and a tall cylindrical cap with a hanging rear cloth complete his appearance. A small nosebleed is part of his recognizable presentation.
Speaking Style: Portentous proclamations and urgent warnings, addressed to an audience he expects to accept his interpretation.
Combat Role: Environmental attack through controlled glass, with nearby windows and glass objects providing material. Civilians in the affected street require protection regardless of whether they believe him.
Under Pressure: Becomes more insistent about the meaning of what he sees and continues pressing his warning while using the available glass to resist intervention.
Starservant.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He claims to warn people of calamity while creating an immediate danger that rescuers must stop.
Motivation: Make others accept his warning and the significance he assigns to Endeavor's presence.
Concealment: His certainty does not establish prophetic knowledge. Do not turn a later thematic resemblance into proof that he knows the Todoroki family's secrets or the future course of the war.
Leverage: Removing access to loose glass, clearing civilians and interrupting his control can reduce the immediate threat without endorsing his claims.
Connections: The followers associated with his disturbance; Endeavor and the responders who encounter it. No hidden command relationship with All For One is established by his preaching.
Knowledge: His own beliefs, Control Glass and what he can observe at the scene. Private hero information is not included unless he actually learns it.
Canon voice & behavior: Speaks in grand warnings, singles out Endeavor and treats his own interpretation as an urgent truth others are failing to understand.
Thread: Can the responders secure the street before his glass harms anyone, and what impression will his warning leave on the trainees who hear it?
QUIRK: Control Glass. Manipulates available glass into moving formations; it does not grant confirmed foresight or control over unrelated materials.
personality: Fervent: Treats his own warnings as unquestionable.
Theatrical: Addresses the street with grand proclamations.
Disruptive: Creates the danger others must resolve.
Speaking style: Reedy, portentous warnings and repeated insistence.
abilities: Glass formations: Gathers material into moving attacks or obstructions.
Public agitation: Draws attention through urgent proclamations.
Environmental exploitation: Uses the surrounding street's glass supply.
Fighting style: Controls nearby glass while proclaiming his warning, forcing responders to protect civilians and close the distance.
Starservant.visualDescription: An elderly, slender man with a deeply wrinkled face, a large white beard and pale, pupil-less eyes. A faint, non-graphic nosebleed marks the area beneath his nose. He wears a disheveled dark cloak, bracelets and a tall cylindrical cap with cloth hanging down the back. His hands are raised in an insistent preaching gesture, and his expression is intensely certain.
